note: Report-summary batch 2: 5 questions answerable from the summary documents ingested with tag claude_report_summaries_20261030b (Touro, Cobre Las Cruces PMR, Hautalampi, Emili). Truth from the report text, written before any system was asked.

questions.question: What reserves and economics did Atalaya report for its Touro copper project in Galicia?

facts: Proven and Probable reserves of about 90.9 Mt at 0.43% Cu (about 392 kt contained copper)
After-tax NPV8 of about US$180 million and IRR 20.5% at US$3.00/lb copper
Initial development capital of about US$165 million and a mine life of about 12 years
From the 2018 NI 43-101 pre-feasibility technical report

questions.question: What is the Cobre Las Cruces polymetallic primary sulphide (PMR) project in Spain expected to cost, and what does it return?

facts: Initial capital of about US$846 million (including 14% contingency)
Pre-tax NPV8 of about US$519 million and pre-tax IRR of 17.4%
Combined Proven + Probable reserve about 41.6 Mt at 1.14% Cu (36.6 Mt underground plus 5.0 Mt stockpile)
First Quantum NI 43-101 report effective 30 September 2023

questions.question: What ore reserve and economics does the Hautalampi nickel-cobalt-copper project in Finland have?

facts: Ore Reserve 4.56 Mt at 0.30% Ni, 0.24% Cu and 0.08% Co (Proven 1.87 Mt, Probable 2.69 Mt)
Capital cost about EUR 74.8 million including 15% contingency
NPV at 5% about EUR 58.8 million and IRR 20%
From AFRY's March 2023 JORC pre-feasibility study for FinnCobalt

questions.question: How large is the Hautalampi nickel deposit's measured and indicated resource?

facts: Measured + Indicated 9.33 Mt at 0.28% Ni, 0.19% Cu and 0.07% Co
Measured 2.81 Mt at 0.35% Ni and Indicated 6.52 Mt at 0.25% Ni
Reported at a 0.25% NiEq cut-off, AFRY estimate of 29 September 2022

questions.question: What is the current mineral resource at Imerys' Emili lithium project in France, and does it have a reserve?

facts: Indicated 210 Mt at 1.01% Li2O and Inferred 163 Mt at 0.99% Li2O
Effective 15 November 2023 at a 0.6% Li2O cut-off; no Mineral Reserve declared
